criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Issuance and Delivery
categories.definition: Queries about obtaining, replacing, or the delivery status of physical or virtual cards.

categories.name: Card Usage and Acceptance
categories.definition: Questions regarding where and how cards can be used, including issues with card acceptance.

categories.name: Card Security and Fraud
categories.definition: Concerns about unauthorized transactions, lost or stolen cards, and account security.

categories.name: Card Fees and Charges
categories.definition: Inquiries about fees associated with card usage, including withdrawals and transactions.

categories.name: Account Closure
categories.definition: Requests to close or delete accounts.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Questions about the process and requirements for verifying identity.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Queries about exchanging currencies and related fees.

categories.name: Top-Up Issues
categories.definition: Problems and questions related to adding funds to an account or card.

categories.name: Transfer Issues
categories.definition: Concerns about money transfers, including delays, failures, and fees.

categories.name: PIN and Password Management
categories.definition: Requests for help with PIN or password setup, changes, or recovery.

categories.name: Account Information Update
categories.definition: Requests to update personal or account information.

categories.name: Refunds and Disputes
categories.definition: Inquiries about obtaining refunds or disputing transactions.

categories.name: Direct Debit Issues
categories.definition: Concerns about unauthorized or incorrect direct debit transactions.

categories.name: App Functionality
categories.definition: Questions about using the app, including troubleshooting and features.
